verdict.rationale: The evidence only offers a generic one-line claim of 'built-in observability' for Workers (docs-22) and AI Gateway request/token/cost metrics (docs-37), neither of which documents a dedicated visitor-behavior/site-performance analytics dashboard (e.g., Web Analytics, RUM, geographic/traffic breakdowns) that a devops-lead would expect. Missing for 10: dedicated visitor analytics product docs, real-user-monitoring metrics, dashboard screenshots or independent corroboration of analytics accuracy/usefulness.
